title: Ojà Live
tagline: Live auctions that pick the right winner every time.
summary: A live auction house built to pick the same winner at the same price, whatever order the bids arrive in.
problem: When two bids land in the same millisecond, an auction must still be fair and repeatable.
note: In development. Load, race and chaos test results arrive in milestones 10 and 11.
features: Bid engine checked with property-based tests
Bid logic in Redis Lua scripts
Design and architecture decisions written up front
why: When two bids land in the same millisecond, a live auction must still pick the same winner at the same price every time. Ojà Live is built to prove that under load, races and failures.
hard: Bid logic runs in Redis Lua scripts and is checked with property-based tests.
Load, race and chaos test results are planned for milestones 10 and 11.
